messages.author: 16644d25568cd19d
messages.subject: Polychoric correlations for intercorrelations
parts:
Hi all,
I'm wondering if someone could tell me how to produce polychoric correlations to put in an intercorrelation table. I have 10 items I need to calculate intercorrelations for on ordinal scale.
I'm pretty new to R, so not sure what package and codes need to be used, and whether I need to calculate each correlation severally, or if R can produce a matrix of these intercorrelations in a single command?
Thanks

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Polychoric correlations for intercorrelations
parts:
The polychoric() function in the psych package will do this.

Jeremy

argument.

Yves.
